ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION.description: Allow additional users to create accounts after the first account has been created.

ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED.description: Allow visitors to use ConvertX without signing in. Enable only when this app is reachable from a trusted local network.

AUTO_DELETE_EVERY_N_HOURS.description: How often ConvertX removes old converted files from local storage.

MAX_CONVERT_PROCESS.description: Maximum number of conversion processes ConvertX may run at once. Use 0 for unlimited.

HIDE_HISTORY.description: Hide the conversion history page from the web interface.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign ConvertX login tokens.

TZ.description: Timezone used for timestamps and cleanup scheduling.

HTTP_ALLOWED.description: Allows login over Lawn's local HTTP URLs.

ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION.description: Allows additional users to create accounts.

ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED.description: Allows users to convert files without signing in.

AUTO_DELETE_EVERY_N_HOURS.description: Interval used to remove old converted files.

MAX_CONVERT_PROCESS.description: Maximum number of concurrent conversion processes.

HIDE_HISTORY.description: Hides the history page in the web interface.

LANGUAGE.description: Language tag used for date formatting.

UNAUTHENTICATED_USER_SHARING.description: Controls whether unauthenticated users share one conversion history.

setup-info.content: Create the first ConvertX account when the web interface opens. Keep account registration disabled unless you want additional local users to sign up.
